edges.reason: initialize writes the _minter parameter into the minter mapping.
batchMint gates execution on minter[msg.sender].
batchStake requires msg.sender to equal the reserve address.
withdraw onlyOwner check relies on msg.sender compared to owner().
batchMint forwards the recipient parameter into _mint.
batchMint forwards tokenIds entries into _mint.
_tokenMetadata element is copied into the local meta struct.
Local meta is stored into tokenMetadata[tokenId].
batchMint increments numPoachers for poacher metadata.
batchMint increments numAnimals for animal metadata.
Loop index i selects the token id minted via _mint.
batchMint calls the _mint operation inside its loop.
batchStake passes the from parameter into _transfer.
batchStake passes tokenIds entries into _transfer.
batchStake calls the _transfer operation inside its loop.
withdraw transfers the whole balance to owner() before completing.
ETH transfer to owner() may re-enter withdraw if owner is a contract.
_authorizeUpgrade (onlyOwner) guards the delegatecall upgrade path.
upgrade authorization depends on msg.sender being the owner.
setReserve writes the reserve state variable.
tokenURI invokes checkExists before reading metadata.
tokenURI reads rhinoMeta to render rhino tokens.
tokenURI reads poacherMeta to render poacher tokens.
setMinter (onlyOwner) writes the minter mapping for the given address.
tokenURI passes its tokenId parameter into checkExists.
tokenURI uses tokenId to read packed metadata from tokenMetadata.
setRhinoMeta writes the rhinoMeta state variable.
setPoacherMeta writes the poacherMeta state variable.
setBaseUri writes the baseURI state variable.
Local meta in tokenURI is passed to rhinoMeta renderer.

normalization_plan.reason: The _minter parameter only exists to seed the minter mapping during initialize.
The recipient parameter flows directly into the _mint unsafe operation.
The _tokenMetadata array is consumed only by the batchMint loop.
The tokenIds array determines which ids are passed to _mint.
The from parameter is used only as the source of the _transfer call.
The staked tokenIds array is consumed only by the _transfer call.
The setMinter address parameter is used solely to update the minter mapping inside setMinter.
The tokenURI tokenId parameter is consumed by the tokenURI function.
The local meta struct is a temporary inside batchMint before storage.
The loop index i exists only to drive the batchMint iteration.
The local meta struct is a temporary read inside tokenURI.
